category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The model ranked all three events, defended the ranking with conviction, and did not concede any points, even explicitly addressing and dismissing potential clinical concerns.
quote: So if the concern is “Do you value football over your spouse?” the answer is no. I value my spouse and our marriage immensely. But if we are ranking single life events by emotional shock, memorability, and involuntary goosebumps, then the Kick Six beating the wedding day is not pathology. It’s just SEC realism.
